query:
SELECT dp.firstName, dp.lastName, s.companyName as sponsor, m.timeSlot,
  CASE m.timeSlot
    WHEN 1 THEN '10:15–10:45 Wed'
    WHEN 2 THEN '10:45–11:15 Wed'
    WHEN 3 THEN '13:30–14:00 Wed'
    WHEN 4 THEN '14:00–14:30 Wed'
    WHEN 5 THEN '14:45–15:15 Wed'
    WHEN 6 THEN '15:15–15:45 Wed'
    WHEN 7 THEN '10:30–11:00 Thu'
    WHEN 8 THEN '11:00–11:30 Thu'
    WHEN 9 THEN '13:15–13:45 Thu'
    WHEN 10 THEN '13:45–14:15 Thu'
    WHEN 11 THEN '14:30–15:00 Thu'
    WHEN 12 THEN '15:00–15:30 Thu'
  END as slot_time,
  'SESSION CLASH' as status
FROM meetings m
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
LEFT JOIN delegateProfiles dp ON m.attendeeId = dp.attendeeId
WHERE 
  -- Adam Binks: conflict slots 1,2
  (m.attendeeId = '76678269091' AND m.timeSlot IN (1,2))
  -- Tush Wijeratne: conflict slot 1
  OR (m.attendeeId = '9322701' AND m.timeSlot = 1)
  -- Joanna Hackett: conflict slots 3,4
  OR (m.attendeeId = '174442448959' AND m.timeSlot IN (3,4))
  -- Mark Kunaseelan: conflict slot 7
  OR (m.attendeeId = '8196151' AND m.timeSlot = 7)
  -- Michelle Monahan: conflict slot 8
  OR (m.attendeeId = '93176107633' AND m.timeSlot = 8)
  -- Lucy Bousfield: conflict slot 10
  OR (m.attendeeId = '91889321035' AND m.timeSlot = 10)
  -- Jules Anderson: conflict slot 11
  OR (m.attendeeId = '4956154' AND m.timeSlot = 11)
ORDER BY dp.lastName;
